basic_details.job_title: IIT Roorkee Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for Junior Research Fellow/Senior Research Fellow Posts
basic_details.short_information: IIT Roorkee Recruitment 2026 is for 1 Junior Research Fellow/Senior Research Fellow post in the DRDO-sponsored project "Centrifuge and Numerical Modelling of Underground Explosions in Soils" in the Department of Civil Engineering, Indian Institute of Technology, Roorkee. The post lasts 3 Years and pays Rs. 37000 - Rs. 42000 + HRA. Only Indian nationals may apply. Candidates need a B.Tech. in Civil Engineering and an M.Tech. in Geotechnical Engineering/Soil Dynamics with GATE qualification. Applications go by email to the Principal Investigator by 5 November 2026, 11:59 PM.

how_to_apply: Email your application to the office of the Principal Investigator at [email protected]. It must be sent by 5 November 2026, 11:59 PM.
Application with a detailed CV including a chronological discipline of degrees/certificates and marks obtained
Experience, including research, industry, and others
Knowledge of finite element software and programming skills
Self-attested copies of the degree/certificate and experience certificate

content_sections.heading: IIT Roorkee Recruitment 2026 at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

rows.details: Centrifuge and Numerical Modelling of Underground Explosions in Soils

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from Indian nationals only. The essential qualification for the Junior Research Fellow/Senior Research Fellow post is: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering (min CGPA 7.0/10 or 70%), and M.Tech. Geotechnical Engineering/Soil Dynamics (min CGPA 6.5/10 or 65%) with GATE qualification Candidates must make sure they are eligible for the position before they appear for the interview. When choosing between candidates with equal qualifications and experience, preference will be given to SC/ST candidates. For the discipline-specific eligibility of the post, see the official notification. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The pay (called "emoluments" in the notice) is Rs. 37000 - Rs. 42000, with HRA paid on top. The notice does not say which part of this range applies to the JRF level and which to the SRF level. The project position is for 3 Years. The notice says the selected candidate may get an opportunity for PhD admission.

content_sections.heading: IIT Roorkee Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists this work for the Junior Research Fellow/Senior Research Fellow: Geotechnical Characterization, Triaxial tests Centrifuge tests at IIT Bombay Conduct numerical modelling Analysis and preparation of reports

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Roorkee Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Email your application to the office of the Principal Investigator at [email protected] . It must be sent by 5 November 2026, 11:59 PM. Documents named in the notice Application with a detailed CV including a chronological discipline of degrees/certificates and marks obtained Degree Certificates Experience Certificates Experience, including research, industry, and others Knowledge of finite element software and programming skills Self-attested copies of the degree/certificate and experience certificate Abstract of MTech thesis

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates are selected through an interview. Candidates who want to appear for the interview must first send their application and documents by email. At the interview, bring the original degree(s)/certificate(s) and experience certificate(s) for verification. No TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview.
